_help: Ship changes, wings and fighting - in space and on foot. {ship}, {Name} and {Victim} are filled in by the game. A _OnFoot key is used instead when you are on foot. A _Mood suffix is only used in that mood.
ShipyardSwap_Friendly: The {ship}, lovely. Let's see what she can do.
ShipyardSwap_Close: A new ship, the {ship}. Look after her. And me.
The {ship}. I like how she feels already.
ShipyardSwap_Sarcastic: The {ship}. Try not to break this one.
Oh, the {ship} now. The old one was getting jealous.
WingInvite: {Name} has invited you to a wing.
ShipTargeted_Wanted: That one has a bounty on it.
ShipTargeted_Wanted_Sarcastic: A wanted ship. How convenient for your wallet.
Interdiction_Success: Interdiction successful. They're out of supercruise.
Interdiction_Failed: Lost them. They're still in supercruise.
PVPKill_Sarcastic: A real person. Hope they're not too upset.
Bounty_OnFoot_Sarcastic: One less problem. There's always another.
UnderAttack_OnFoot_Frustrated: They're shooting at us! Do something!
Died_OnFoot: Commander down. Medical recovery under way.
That's a bad one. Recovering you now.
Died_OnFoot_Sarcastic: You'll feel that in the morning.
React_WantedKill: Good kill, Commander. Another wanted criminal off the lanes.
Nice shooting. That one deserved it.
React_WantedKill_Friendly: Lovely work, Commander. Another outlaw down.
That's what I like to see.
React_WantedKill_Close: You're so good at that. Don't tell anyone I said so.
React_WantedKill_Sarcastic: Well, you hit something. Good for you.
A bounty. Are you feeling alright?
